newsitem.title: USA: Central and South West closes placement.
newsitem.headline: Central and South West closes placement.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said Tuesday that its subsidiary, CSW Energy Inc, has closed and funded a $200 million, five-year 144A senior note program.
The proceeds are to be used for the acquisition, development and construction of electric generation assets in the United States and to make intercompany loans to CSW International Inc.
CSW International Inc would use the proceeds for the acquisition, development and construction of electric generation, transmission and distribution assets outside the United States.
CSW Energy said the placement receive an investment-grade ratings of BBB+ from Standard & Poor's and Duff & Phelps, and a Baa2 rating with a positive outlook from Moody's Investors Services.
A 144A senior note is a private placement debt offering sold to institutional accredited investors and qualified institutional buyers.
The notes were structured with a five-year bullet maturity and a coupon of 6.875 percent.
